rows.name: size
rows.description: Set the size of the textfield.

rows.name: disabled
rows.description: Whether the input is disabled. Disables interaction and applies a disabled style.

rows.name: readonly
rows.description: Whether the input is read-only. Prevents changes but allows focus and text selection.

rows.name: placeholderText
rows.description: Placeholder text displayed inside the input when it's empty.

rows.name: prefixText
rows.description: The prefix text for the input value, typically used for currency symbols.

rows.name: suffixText
rows.description: The suffix text for the input value, typically used for units of measure.

rows.name: labelText
rows.description: The label of the input field.

rows.name: supportMessageProps
rows.description: Props for displaying support messages such as helper text.

rows.name: textFieldIconProps
rows.description: Additional props to customize the right side icon used inside the TextField.

rows.name: inputProps
rows.type: Props to apply directly to the underlying <input> element. value and defaultValue are excluded. | <input> | value | defaultValue
